verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

evidence: [R] 100% of mildly late (>= 120s) trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 59 St: 6, at 45 St: 1.
[N] 100% of mildly late (>= 120s) trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 59 St: 11. Largest time loss on segment 45 St -> 36 St (median +42s vs schedule).

[D] 86% of mildly late (>= 120s) trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 50 St: 3, at 36 St: 2, on approach from Prospect Av: 1, at 9 Av: 1. Largest time loss on segment 9 Av -> 36 St (median +81s vs schedule).
43% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 90%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
22% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'police' alert was active for the line (problem rate 31% with an alert vs 14% without, lift 2.2x).
Weekend problem rate is 1.6x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 29% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
Adverse-weather days have 1.8x the problem rate (4 adverse days).
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 641s on average vs 102s otherwise (6.3x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
6% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'switch' alert was active for the line (problem rate 31% with an alert vs 14% without, lift 2.2x).
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 33% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 20% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on R, N, D, W during 22:00-23:00: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for R, N, D, W; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for R, N, D, W; add supplement trains or move work windows off 22:00-23:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Activate the adverse-weather plan (drainage checks, heat-related speed restrictions review, snow plan) on forecast adverse days
recommendations.rationale: Problem rate rises on adverse-weather days.

recommendations.action: Increase collection: record all stops (not only the target) and keep predictions to strengthen upstream/terminal lenses
recommendations.rationale: The available evidence does not isolate a cause.
recommendations.expected_effect: Better attribution in the next run.

recommendations.action: On rainy/snowy days budget extra time for R, N, D, W at 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Weather sensitivity is measurable at this station.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
